title: An XRP treasury SPAC surges nearly 300% ahead of Evernorth merger
summary: Armada Acquisition Corp. II rose about 270% last week, leaving the thinly traded shell at nearly four times its roughly $10.50 trust value before merging with Evernorth, an XPR treasury company.
